name: Spencer L. Allred
prior_offices: Lincoln County attorney (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Spencer L. Allred is the Lincoln County attorney and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. SVI-NEWS reported that the incumbent won the August 2026 Republican primary with 3,090 votes over Carmen L. Patterson and that the general-election race was then unopposed.
